n = int(input())
b = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
diffSum = [0] * n
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
maxIdx = 0
idx = 1

for i in range(n - 1):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        diffSum[idx] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i])
        idx += 1

diffSum = diffSum[:idx]
diffSum.sort()

result = 0
for i in range(1, idx):
    diffSum[i] += diffSum[i - 1]
    if diffSum[i] <= b:
        result = i

print(result)
